sources.title: Particle Creation by Black Holes
sources.read_scope: Original PDF: relevant pp.199–206,210–211,219 and selected backreaction passages; Eq.(2.29). Locally extracted.
sources.supports: Late outgoing mode thermal factor including absorption coefficient; semiclassical assumptions and breakdown.
sources.does_not_support: Full evaporation unitarity or universal singularity resolution.

sources.title: Black Holes and Entropy
sources.read_scope: Publisher abstract and original scan pp.2337–2339 visually inspected, Eqs.(14)–(19).
sources.supports: Area proportionality, historical information argument and generalized entropy proposal.
sources.does_not_support: Historical exact derivation of modern 1/4 coefficient.

sources.title: On the duality condition for a Hermitian scalar field
sources.read_scope: Original Berkeley reprint: introduction and assumptions; Theorem 2; p.998 identifying Delta=exp(2pi K).
sources.supports: Geometric modular flow for the specified relativistic wedge/vacuum setting.
sources.does_not_support: Arbitrary algebra-state pair determines spacetime or calibrated physical time.

sources.title: The four laws of black hole mechanics
sources.read_scope: Indexed original p.162, unit norm asymptotic Killing vector; first law cross-checked Hawking p.203 and Wald Eq.(25). No complete proof audit.
sources.supports: Stationary normalization and first-law mechanical framework.
sources.does_not_support: Entropy as simple arbitrary subsystem von Neumann entropy.

sources.title: Black Holes in the Early Universe
sources.supports: Event horizon relative to causal infinity, apparent horizon distinction, global hypotheses.
sources.does_not_support: Any inaccessible finite subsystem is a black hole.

sources.title: Black Hole Entropy is Noether Charge
sources.supports: Normalization, general diffeomorphism-invariant stationary first law and Noether charge entropy.
sources.does_not_support: General dynamic second law or universal area formula in arbitrary gravity.

sources.title: The entropy of bulk quantum fields and the entanglement wedge of an evaporating black hole
sources.read_scope: Original abstract and introduction incl. generalized entropy/QES selection and explicit JT+CFT+bath assumptions.
sources.supports: QES transition and Page-like behavior in specified semiclassical holographic model.
sources.does_not_support: Complete four-dimensional evaporation dynamics, universal singularity resolution, or generic causal signaling from behind an event horizon.

sources.title: Gravitational Collapse and Space-Time Singularities
sources.read_scope: Original pp.57–59, especially assumptions and null completeness contradiction pp.58–59.
sources.supports: Classical geodesic incompleteness under stated hypotheses.
sources.does_not_support: Constructed quantum continuation or event horizon without extra global information.
